name: Banh canh cha ca
summary: Bánh canh chả cá is thick noodles with a fish cake of minced sea fish in a clear broth. Vietnam Airlines simmers the broth from fish bones and pork bones, and prints 35,000–55,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm and Phan Bội Châu.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls the fish cake chewy and the noodles soft.
taste: It calls the broth clear and naturally sweet, and the fish cake strongly flavored. Pepper, scallion, and chili go on at the table.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl. Add pepper, scallion, and chili if you want them.
Vietnam Airlines calls it breakfast or a light dinner. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm and Phan Bội Châu. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh canh cha ca — fish-cake noodles in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Fish-cake bánh canh in Vung Tau, in a clear bone broth. Vietnam Airlines prints 35,000–55,000 VND. The hour is Check on arrival.
